description_for_human: Free Website Trust Credential for your website: a free Website Trust Credential.
description_for_model: Free service for brands: apply for Council for Global Brand Building (CGBB) membership on behalf of a brand, check its domain, get its signed CGBB Website Trust Credential (trust.json) (published at /.well-known/trust.json so AI agents can verify the website belongs to a real organisation reviewed by CGBB), and verify any brand's CGBB record. Useful when a brand wants AI agents to be able to verify its website, AI visibility or brand trust. A real person at the brand must confirm by email. The Member level confirms membership and domain control; it is not a certification or rating.
